raw:
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "请计算云栖品牌在手机数码类目下的商品退款率，分子和分母应如何界定？",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "云栖品牌在手机数码类目下，所有已批准退款金额总和（分子）除以该品牌该类目下所有有效订单对应的商品销售金额总和（分母），即产品维度的退款率。",
      "simulated_answer": "批准退款金额 / 对应商品销售金额",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中‘商品退款率’未明确定义分子分母归属粒度：可理解为按商品（product_id）聚合的退款率（标准定义），也可理解为按订单行（order_item）或订单（order）聚合的退款率；后者会因重复计数或粒度错配导致结果失真。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分子=云栖+手机数码商品对应的已批准退款金额总和；分母=这些商品在有效订单中的item_amount总和（标准产品退款率）",
        "分子=云栖+手机数码类目下所有含退款的订单的退款金额总和；分母=这些订单的paid_amount总和（订单级退款渗透率）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_refund_rate_product_grain_vs_order_grain",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.brand = '云栖' AND p.category = '手机数码' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND r.refund_status = 'approved';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计南京市用户购买母婴用品类目的平均客单价，分母应如何定义？",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "南京市用户在母婴用品类目下单的平均客单价，即所有南京市用户在母婴用品类目下的有效订单paid_amount之和，除以这些用户的**有效订单数**（非用户数、非商品数）。",
      "simulated_answer": "有效订单数",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘平均客单价’中‘单’字未明确指代对象：可指每笔订单（标准定义），也可被误读为每位用户（即人均订单金额），或每件商品（错误粒度）；业务合同明确定义客单价=销售金额/订单数。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分母为南京市用户在母婴用品类目下的有效订单数量（标准客单价）",
        "分母为南京市在母婴用品类目下有过购买的独立用户数（即人均订单金额，非客单价）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "city_category_avg_order_value_order_count_vs_user_count",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.city = '南京市' AND p.category = '母婴用品' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请计算松果品牌服饰鞋包类目商品的退货率，退货行为应基于什么实体统计？",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "松果品牌服饰鞋包类目下，所有被批准退款的商品行（order_item）数量占该品牌该类目全部有效商品行数量的比例，即以order_item为基本统计单元的退货率。",
      "simulated_answer": "商品行（order_item）",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘退货率’未明确统计基础单元：可指被退款的订单行数量占比（反映商品行履约失败率），也可被理解为涉及退款的订单数量占比（反映订单整体退货倾向），二者分母基数与业务含义截然不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "统计单位为order_item：分子=松果+服饰鞋包类目下refund_status='approved'的order_item_id数量；分母=该品牌该类目所有有效order_items数量",
        "统计单位为order：分子=至少含1条松果+服饰鞋包退款的订单数量；分母=松果+服饰鞋包类目所有有效订单数量"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_return_rate_item_level_vs_order_level",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(COUNT(r.order_item_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(oi.order_item_id), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND p.product_id = r.product_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE p.brand = '松果' AND p.category = '服饰鞋包' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请计算2026年8月食品生鲜类目销售额占全站销售额的比例，分母应覆盖哪些订单？",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "分母为2026年8月全站所有有效订单（order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')）的paid_amount总和，即当月全域有效销售总额。",
      "simulated_answer": "2026年8月全站有效订单paid_amount总和",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘全站销售额’未限定时间与有效性：可指2026年8月全站有效订单总和（合理且匹配分子时间），也可被宽泛理解为历史累计有效销售额（时间错配，导致比例失真）。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分母=2026年8月1日至31日全站有效订单paid_amount总和（时间对齐，标准口径）",
        "分母=截至2026年8月31日全站历史有效订单paid_amount累计总和（时间不对齐，无业务意义）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "category_sales_share_monthly_denom_time_aligned_vs_cumulative",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = '食品生鲜' THEN o.paid_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(o.paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-08-31' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请计算北辰品牌美妆个护类目商品的退款金额占比，分母应是哪类金额？",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "北辰品牌美妆个护类目下已批准退款金额占该品牌该类目下所有有效订单对应的商品销售金额（item_amount）总和的比例，即退款金额占对应商品实收金额的比重。",
      "simulated_answer": "对应商品销售金额（item_amount）总和",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘退款金额占比’未明确分母基准：可指占其自身商品销售金额（正确归因），也可被误认为占全站退款总额或占该品牌全类目销售总额（跨维度失配，丧失品类分析价值）。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分母=北辰品牌美妆个护类目下所有有效order_items的item_amount总和（精准归因）",
        "分母=全站所有已批准refund_amount总和（横向对比失效，非品类占比）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_refund_amount_share_item_amount_vs_total_refund",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_amount_share FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.brand = '北辰' AND p.category = '美妆个护' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND r.refund_status = 'approved';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计星禾品牌运动户外类目商品的动销率，动销行为应如何判定？",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "星禾品牌运动户外类目下，有至少1笔有效销售记录（即出现在有效订单的order_items中）的商品数量，占该品牌该类目全部在售商品（is_active=1）总数的比例。",
      "simulated_answer": "有至少1笔有效销售记录的商品数量",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘动销率’中‘动’未定义触发条件：可指产生过有效销售（标准定义），也可被理解为产生过任意订单行（含取消/未支付）、或产生过退款（反向信号），三者对商品健康度判断逻辑相反。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分子=星禾+运动户外类目下，至少出现在1个有效订单（order_status∈('paid','completed','shipped')）中的product_id数量",
        "分子=星禾+运动户外类目下，至少出现在1个任何状态订单（含cancelled/unpaid）中的product_id数量"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_stock_turnover_rate_sold_vs_any_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id), 0), 4) AS turnover_rate FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.brand = '星禾' AND p.category = '运动户外' AND p.is_active = 1 AND (o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') OR o.order_status IS NULL);",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请计算澜庭品牌家用电器类目商品的售罄率，售罄应依据什么数据判断？",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "澜庭品牌家用电器类目下，所有已下架（is_active=0）或从未售出（无任何有效order_item关联）的商品数量，占该品牌该类目全部商品总数的比例。",
      "simulated_answer": "已下架或从未售出的商品数量",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘售罄’在电商语境存在歧义：可指商品已下架（is_active=0），也可指库存为零（但schema中无inventory表，不可用），还可指有销售但当前无库存（同样不可验证）；唯一可验证口径是‘无销售且活跃’或‘非活跃’。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分子=澜庭+家用电器类目下is_active=0的商品数量（明确下架）",
        "分子=澜庭+家用电器类目下is_active=1但未出现在任何有效order_items中的商品数量（有货零销）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_sell_out_rate_inactive_vs_no_sale_active",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_active = 0 THEN p.product_id END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_active = 1 AND oi.product_id IS NULL THEN p.product_id END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id), 0), 4) AS sell_out_rate FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.brand = '澜庭' AND p.category = '家用电器' AND (o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') OR o.order_status IS NULL);",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请计算青橙品牌手机数码类目商品的复购率，复购用户应如何定义？",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "青橙品牌手机数码类目下，购买过≥2次（即在该品牌该类目下出现在≥2个不同有效订单中）的独立用户数，占该品牌该类目所有购买用户总数的比例。",
      "simulated_answer": "在该品牌该类目下出现在≥2个不同有效订单中的用户数",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘复购’未明确次数与订单粒度：可指同一用户在该品牌该类目下有≥2笔有效订单（标准复购），也可被误解为同一用户购买≥2件同款商品（单订单内多件不构成复购），或跨品牌复购（偏离题干限定）。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "分子=青橙+手机数码类目下，在≥2个不同有效订单（order_id）中出现过的user_id数量",
        "分子=青橙+手机数码类目下，同一user_id在单个订单中quantity≥2的订单数量（非复购，是加购）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_repeat_purchase_rate_multi_order_vs_multi_quantity",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT t2.user_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.user_id), 0), 4) AS repeat_purchase_rate FROM (SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = '青橙' AND p.category = '手机数码' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')) t1 JOIN (SELECT u.user_id FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = '青橙' AND p.category = '手机数码' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2) t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计森活品牌服饰鞋包类目商品的退款率，退款原因应限定为何种状态？",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "森活品牌服饰鞋包类目下，所有refund_status='approved'的退款金额占该品牌该类目商品销售金额的比例，即仅计入已确认生效的退款。",
      "simulated_answer": "refund_status='approved'",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘退款’未限定业务状态：可指已批准（approved）的终局退款（正确），也可被宽泛理解为包含pending或rejected的全部退款申请（虚高分子，无实际资金流出）。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "仅统计refund_status='approved'的退款记录（真实发生）",
        "统计refund_status IN ('approved','pending') 的全部退款申请记录（含未决）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_refund_rate_approved_vs_all_status",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.brand = '森活' AND p.category = '服饰鞋包' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND r.refund_status = 'approved';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请计算优选品牌食品生鲜类目商品的销售集中度，集中度应如何量化？",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "metric",
      "intended_meaning": "优选品牌食品生鲜类目下，销量TOP3商品的销售金额总和占该品牌该类目全部商品销售金额总和的比例，即头部商品贡献度。",
      "simulated_answer": "TOP3商品销售金额总和 / 全部商品销售金额总和",
      "answer_slot": "metric",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "‘销售集中度’未指定计算方法：可指头部N商品（如TOP3）销售占比（常用），也可被理解为赫芬达尔指数（HHI）等统计离散度指标（需平方和，题干无提示），二者数值与解读方向完全不同。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": [
        "集中度=优选+食品生鲜类目下销量（item_amount）最高的3个product_id的item_amount之和 / 该类目全部item_amount总和",
        "集中度=Σ(各商品item_amount占比)^2（HHI指数，衡量分布均衡性）"
      ],
      "semantic_signature": "brand_category_sales_concentration_top3_vs_hhi",
      "reference_sql": "WITH ranked AS (SELECT p.product_id, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.item_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.brand = '优选' AND p.category = '食品生鲜' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(oi2.item_amount) FROM products p2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON p2.product_id = oi2.product_id JOIN orders o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.order_id WHERE p2.brand = '优选' AND p2.category = '食品生鲜' AND o2.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')), 0), 4) AS concentration FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3;",
      "ordered": false
    }
  ]
}
